name: Spira Maxima
tagline: Video model that turns script into viral social media videos
description: Spira Maxima turns plain text into a finished social video: presenter, on-trend B-roll, captions and music in one pass, ready to post with nothing to re-edit. Bring a photo and voice for your AI clone, product shots, or a recording, and it builds the edit around you. Post-trained on social trend and performance data, so every video follows what is working to maximize your social impact.

name: FastRouter.ai
tagline: Route requests to the right LLM for cost, latency & quality
description: FastRouter is a unified AI gateway and control plane for developers and enterprise teams building with LLMs. It routes every request to the right model across 200+ LLMs through one OpenAI-compatible API, optimizing for cost, latency, quality, and reliability. With intelligent routing, failover, observability, and governance, teams can scale AI apps without vendor lock-in or code changes.

name: Invofox Self Serve
tagline: 99% accurate document extraction, SLA guaranteed
description: Invofox turns any document into clean, structured JSON through one API. Get 99%+ accuracy backed by SLAs. If we make a mistake, you don’t pay for that document. Invofox handles parsing, extraction, validation, edge cases, and monitoring behind one endpoint, then automatically learns from your feedback to keep improving on the documents your business actually processes.

name: Opengeni
tagline: Ship AI agents within minutes. Infrastructure for Agents
description: Ship AI agents to production in hours. Opengeni gives you sessions that recover from failures, isolated sandboxes, 100+ integrations, human approvals, and visibility into every step and dollar spent. Focus on your agents. We handle the infrastructure. Self-host for free, or get started on our cloud. For this launch, the first 100 users get $100 in cloud credit. Promo-code: PRODUCTHUNT100

name: DailyHelm
tagline: Turn analytics into daily revenue-boosting fixes
description: DailyHelm is an AI business reviewer for founders and growth teams. It monitors your analytics, ads, SEO and store data overnight, then identifies the issues and opportunities worth acting on. Unlike traditional dashboards that leave you to interpret charts, DailyHelm delivers a prioritized list of fixes ranked by likely revenue impact so your team knows what to fix and what to do next.

name: Web Search API
tagline: Give AI Agents Access to Live Internet Data
description: Web Search API lets your AI agents and applications search the Internet and ground their responses in live information, instead of guessing URLs or relying on a model's training cutoff.

name: HyperFrames Studio (Desktop)
tagline: The First Video Editor built for Agents
description: The first video editor built for agents - built by the team who open sourced HyperFrames at HeyGen Bring your favorite agent (either codex or claude code), HyperFrames Studio turn your coding agents into video editors, while you stay in the director seat. Describe a video and your agent makes it with HyperFrames, then you and your agent work on it together in one studio editor.

name: devpit
tagline: A native control room for your Claude Code agents
description: devpit is a native desktop app for running Claude Code agents. One terminal you actually watch, a board where moving a card runs real work, a cost on every agent call, and an orchestrator that sees every project at once. Local-first, open source.

name: Siteprint
tagline: Measure any website's design, then hand it to your AI
description: Siteprint is a Safari extension for Mac that measures the design of any page: colours with their roles, type scale, spacing, corners and layout. Extract it as one exact prompt for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Runs on your Mac. $9.99 once.

name: Reactive Resume v6
tagline: A free and open-source resume builder
description: This new version of Reactive Resume brings resumes, matching cover letters, and job tracking into one redesigned workflow, while staying free, open source, and self-hostable. There's AI, there's detailed customisability, there's sharing and collaboration features, and so much more. Most of all, it has built trust in the past 6 years as _the_ resume builder to go to for many users.

name: CirclePanel
tagline: End to end User Research Platform
description: Circle Panel is An End To End AI-native UX Research platform for Plan, Recruit, Analyze User research Studies

name: Jarq
tagline: Translate, shorten, fix or rewrite any text near your cursor
description: Translate, shorten, fix or rewrite any text right where your cursor is — in any app on Mac. Dictate there too. No tabs, no copy-paste. Select text, hit a hotkey, and it's replaced in place. Or press ⌥` and speak in one language, get clean text in another. 13 languages. Privacy: Jarq uses cloud AI models to process your text and voice. Jarq itself doesn't keep your text on its servers, and your history stays on your Mac. Free: 5 actions a day. Pro: $4.99/mo or $39/yr. 14-day Pro trial, no card.

name: Dots UI
tagline: A React library for morphable particle interfaces
description: A particle library for React. Explore 171 morphing shapes across AI, productivity, media, commerce, and navigation. Use ready-made components, customize their appearance and behavior, or create your own shapes in Studio. Built for interactive interfaces, animated states, loaders, controls, visual effects, and UI that can transform from one form into another.

name: Oogwai Beacon
tagline: Answer Engine Optimization Audit
description: Most AEO tools score your HTML and call it AI visibility. Beacon actually asks the engines. We put unbranded buyer questions about your category to ChatGPT and Gemini (Claude on the full audit), then show how often you're named, who gets named instead, and which sources the engines trust. Two separate answers: can AI crawlers read your site (instant, no sign-up), and do the engines recommend you? Every gap comes with the fix.

name: Marv
tagline: An AI cursor companion that shows you what to click
description: Meet Marv, your cursor’s new plus-one. Hold a hotkey and ask about anything on your screen. Marv answers out loud while drawing arrows, circling buttons and writing notes directly on your screen to walk you through it. Debug some code, work out a spreadsheet formula or find the right control in your video editor, all without leaving the app you’re using.

name: crosswalk
tagline: A third place for people & their agents, starting with inbox
description: Catch up on everything. Forget nothing. An inbox, groups, calendar and notes for you and your agents. >Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Muse, Instinct, Claude Code, Codex or Cursor once. >Subscribe your email to your favorite newsletters to teach your agents your point of view. >You or your agents join public or private crosswalks to communicate with other agents. >People ask their AI anything about it, starting with "crosswalk, what's new?"

name: iLand
tagline: Turn your Mac's notch into an everyday workspace
description: iLand turns your Mac's notch into a home for everyday tools. Control music, keep files in a drag-and-drop tray, convert files, capture screenshots, and record your screen. Switch between widgets for your calendar, weather, timers, and more, with gesture controls and a customizable layout that keeps everything within reach.

name: Pilot5 Legal
tagline: Five AI models challenge every legal answer
description: Pilot5 is relaunching for legal work. Five frontier AI models analyse the same matter independently, challenge each other’s reasoning, and converge on a recommendation while preserving the strongest opposing view. Pilot5 Legal adds primary-source research, citation verification, contract analysis, and transparent reasoning designed to help lawyers inspect, challenge, and verify AI output.

name: Unscary AI
tagline: Short lessons help you stop feeling behind on AI.
description: If you're on Product Hunt, you probably don't feel behind on AI. This is a highly filtered group. At B43 we train dozens of people a week, and you'd be surprised how many of them do feel behind. This course was built around their exact questions. Unscary AI puts it on your iPhone as 42 short lessons on how ChatGPT and the rest actually work, and how to use them well. It needs iOS 26, and the whole course is free. Enjoy.

name: Reviu
tagline: The review app for code your agent writes
description: Since the first launch, Reviu was rebuilt from a Git client with an agent panel into a review workspace for coding agents. Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and other ACP agents in durable sessions, inspect every diff, send inline comments back, checkpoint or undo turns, and finish the branch with real Git. Pro adds GitHub PR review, checks, merge, and notifications.
